Fields.Name: Summon Sign VFX ID - To Others
Fields.Description: Effect (FXR) of summon signs with this role as other players see them; group-password signs use this field of their group-password row. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Summon Sign VFX ID - To Self
Fields.Description: Effect (FXR) of your own summon sign with this role. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Summon Anim ID
Fields.Description: Anime ID that plays when you are summoned and start the game

Fields.Name: Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: ItemLot awarded when completing your multiplayer goal

Fields.Name: Voice Chat Group
Fields.Description: Bit mask: two players can voice chat only if their roles' groups share a bit (and voice chat is enabled in the options).

Fields.Name: Name Color
Fields.Description: Colour of the role name shown for characters with this role: 1 friendly, 2 hostile.

Fields.Name: Role Name ID
Fields.Description: Text ID of role name displayed on FE of network PC

Fields.Name: Summon Preview Phantom ID
Fields.Description: PhantomParam row for the ghost shown at a summon sign (replay ghosts of role type 11), using the role of the sign's owner. -1: no phantom look.

Fields.Name: NPC Summon Start - Animation ID
Fields.Description: Anime ID to play when a player other than the player is summoned and the game starts
